meta.title: Completion raw_ident label fail
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#19699 (fix: Escape raw names in labels properly)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2025-04-28 and 2025-05-05; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2025-05-05. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: Label completion printed the raw label name without its r# prefix, inserting 'break instead of 'r#break, and a keyword is not a valid label name.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: a binary crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/main.rs. Request completion after the quote in "break ';" (line 2, character 15, before the semicolon) and accept the label item. Reported: "break 'break;" (labels cannot use keyword names); expected "break 'r#break;". Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the original did not have.
